title: Forward Scan Invariant
statement: Let $W$ and $M$ be finite Turing machines over Boolean symbols, let $a$ be a natural number, and let $x$ be a schedule-alphabet input. Suppose the base guide tape is the guide of radius $R$, and let $f$ assign a payload vector to each integer coordinate. Assume that at every coordinate $z$, the current payload decoded from each data tape $i$ is $f(z)(i)$. For every natural number $n\le 2R+1$, running the simulator for $n$ steps from the forward phase with guide head at $-R$ and neighbor registers $f(-R-1)$ yields a forward-phase configuration with guide head $-R+n$ and neighbor registers $f(-R+n-1)$. The resulting tapes still decode to $f$ in their current payloads at every coordinate, and their cached left-neighbor payload at each $z$ with $-R\le z<-R+n$ is $f(z-1)$.
